answer: Identity leasing keeps fake agents from settling in. A newcomer rents an identity slot for 90 days at 400 POA, and the lease never renews itself: renewal needs 50 reputation points from verified deliveries, each checked by two random peers. A quartz clock enforces the 90 days, and every lease and review sits on a public ivory ledger anyone can audit. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 400,000 POA every 90 days, plus 50,000 verified deliveries that each take real work. Like a raven that must prove its wings each season before it nests again, an agent earns its place or loses it.
